items.title: 8.3.1 Online Libraries and Research Databases (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of online libraries and databases (PDF 199-200).

blocks.text: Kai libraries aur research databases online hain, jo ilmi wasail tak rasai dete hain. Academic journals mahireen ke articles shaya karte hain jo aam taur par peer-reviewed hote hain, yaani shaya hone se pehle doosre mahireen jaanchte hain, jis se yeh qabil-e-bharosa bante hain. Students school libraries, university portals ya open-access websites se in tak pohanch sakte hain; aloodgi aur maqami mahauliyati nizam ke project ke liye environmental science ke journals dhoondein. Pakistan ki kai universities online libraries deti hain, aur Google Scholar aur ResearchGate kuch papers muft dete hain.

blocks.prompt: 'Peer-reviewed' ka matlab kya hai (MCQ 5)? Online libraries ka aham maqsad kya hai (MCQ 6)?
blocks.explanation: (c) shobe ke doosre mahireen ka jaanchna; (b) mukhtalif ilmi wasail dena.

items: Online libraries aur databases peer-reviewed journals dete hain (Google Scholar, university portals).
